name: Narin — Ability Nuke
description: Max strength and range to turn Narin's kit into a room-clearing nuke. Cast, watch everything melt.
playstyle: Keep energy up with Zenurik or Energy Nexus. Cast abilities in rotation — range does the work.

name: Koumei — Dice Roller Support
description: Duration and efficiency to keep Koumei's dice rolling. Buff the squad, debuff enemies, never stop casting.
playstyle: Roll dice on cooldown. High duration keeps buffs up; efficiency lets you spam without worry.

name: Temple — Riff Rocker
description: Strength-focused Temple that turns every riff into a stage-clearing blast. Loud, proud, deadly.
playstyle: Build your riff meter with weapon kills, then unleash. Strength scales the blast damage hard.

name: Oraxia — Silent Assassin
description: Duration-heavy stealth build. Stay invisible, pick targets, vanish before anyone notices.
playstyle: Go invisible, line up finishers on priority targets. Duration keeps you ghosted between kills.

name: Dagath — Doom Bringer
description: Max out Dagath's doom-spreading. Enemies die slow, then all at once — deeply satisfying.
playstyle: Spread doom with abilities, let DoTs tick. Strength and duration both matter here.

name: Qorvex — Radiation Fortress
description: Unkillable radiation tank. Stand in the fire, laugh, irradiate everything around you.
playstyle: Stack armor and health. Your presence alone melts crowds with radiation procs.

name: Gyre — Electric Cascade
description: Crit-electric Gyre that chains lightning across the whole tileset. Enemies don't get to move.
playstyle: Keep Cathode Grace active for crit. Cast into groups — the arcs do the rest.

name: Voruna — Pack Hunter Melee
description: Melee-focused Voruna that hunts in a blur. Leap in, shred, leap out — the pack never stops.
playstyle: Use Ulfrun's Descent to gap-close. Melee with high status to proc everything, constantly moving.

name: Citrine — Crystal Guardian
description: The support build every squad wants. Crystals for DR, healing, and buffs — you keep everyone alive.
playstyle: Keep crystals up at all times. High duration = less recasting. Position centrally so the squad stays in range.

name: Kullervo — Heavy Attack Monster
description: The one-shot melee king. Stack combo, heavy attack, watch Steel Path heavies evaporate.
playstyle: Build combo with light attacks, then heavy attack everything. Wrathful Advance teleports you to the next victim.

name: Nova Prime — Unkillable Nuke
description: The ultimate Nova: 90% damage reduction from Null Star plus max-strength Molecular Prime that slows everything 75% and makes enemies explode into each other. Unkillable and room-clearing.
playstyle: Keep Null Star up at all times for 90% DR. Cast Molecular Prime into groups — primed enemies take double damage and chain-explode. Antimatter Drop for single-target burst.

mods.name: Primed Continuity
mods.note: Duration — keeps Null Star particles alive

name: Shedu — Steel Path Shredder
description: Viral + slash meta Shedu that melts Steel Path. Viral halves HP, slash bleeds through armor, AoE pulse groups enemies.
playstyle: Fire into groups — the empty-mag AoE pulse clusters enemies. Viral procs halve HP, Hunter Munitions slash finishes through armor.

name: Tenet Grigori — Steel Path Blender
description: Heavy attack monster. Build combo, heavy attack, watch Steel Path heavies evaporate. Energy waves clear crowds.
playstyle: Light attack to build combo, heavy attack to delete. Wrathful Advance gap-closes between targets.

name: Nautilus Prime — Best Sentinel Setup
description: The ultimate support sentinel: vacuum, auto-revive, energy orbs, and frost priming for Condition Overload.
playstyle: Set and forget. Vacuum grabs loot, Guardian saves you from death, Verglas primes enemies with cold.

name: Burst Laser Prime — Steel Path Shredder
description: Burst-fire crit monster. Viral + slash melts Steel Path — each burst stacks procs fast.
playstyle: Aim for heads — the burst fires tight. Viral halves HP, slash bleeds through armor. Reload is fast, keep firing.

name: Tenet Grigori — Max Damage
description: Combo-scaling monster. At 12x combo: 720% bonus crit, 440% bonus status, Condition Overload multiplying everything. Millions per swing.
playstyle: Build combo with light attacks — never heavy attack (resets combo). Use Naramon focus so combo doesn't decay. At high combo, everything dies in one hit.

mods.name: Blood Rush
mods.note: Crit scales with combo — the big one

name: Felarx — Steel Path Destroyer
description: One of the strongest shotguns in the game. Devastating Attrition evolution makes non-crits hit for +2000%. Viral + slash deletes everything.
playstyle: Evolve with Devastating Attrition. Aim for heads — crits proc slash, non-crits get the massive evolution bonus. Works at any range.
